text:
alex_w: Heads-up — atlas-7b-qlora weights were moved to gs://redwood-models/atlas/7b/qlora-v2 this morning. Need config validation + a quick perf smoke before we add it to the catalog. Who can take tokenizer sanity checks and a bench run?

maria_g: I can do tokenizer sanity. Quick note: last dump had an odd special token mapping, want me to diff tokenizer.json against model.cfg? :mag:

jonah_k: I can run perf on dedicated-a100-40g later today. Which seq_len / batch sweep do you want?

alex_w: Target HW: dedicated-a100-40g (autoscale off for reproducible numbers). Sweep: batch_sizes [1,4,8,16], seq_len 512, iters 200. Use bench script and upload artifacts to gs://redwood-bench/artifacts/. Example command:```bash
./bench/run_perf.sh --model-path gs://redwood-models/atlas/7b/qlora-v2 --device dedicated-a100-40g --batch-sizes "1,4,8,16" --seq-len 512 --iters 200 --out gs://redwood-bench/artifacts/1832054321/
```

sophia_r: Also record the config fields we check for catalog: `vocab_size`, `pad_token_id`, `bos_token_id`, `eos_token_id`, `hidden_size`, `num_heads`, `layer_norm_eps`. If any mismatch with tokenizer.json, call it out in the PR.

maria_g: Quick diff: tokenizer.json vocab_size=50257, special tokens map has "<|pad|>":50256 and "<|bos|>":50256. The model checkpoint metadata was missing `pad_token_id` in model.cfg — will add patch. Also recommend ensuring tokenizers version locked to `tokenizers==0.13.2` for reproducibility.

jonah_k: Bench started. Using the exact command above, no other processes on the node. I'll paste trimmed logs when done. :eyes:

bench-bot: perf job scheduled -> job_id=bench-1832054420, node=dedicated-a100-40g-7, ETA ~12m

bench-bot: perf job completed -> job_id=bench-1832054420, artifacts=gs://redwood-bench/artifacts/bench-1832054420/ (logs + summary.json)

jonah_k: Pasted summary (trimmed):```
BENCH SUMMARY (atlas-7b-qlora on A100-40g)
seq_len=512 iters=200 warmup=50
batch=1  p50=92ms  p95=215ms  tokens/s=68
batch=4  p50=45ms  p95=125ms  tokens/s=312
batch=8  p50=33ms  p95=100ms  tokens/s=610
batch=16 p50=38ms  p95=168ms  tokens/s=930
notes: batch16 increases p95 (sporadic stalls) likely KV memcpy + GPU allocation boundary at seq_len 512. No OOMs.
```

maria_g: Tokenizer patch: added `pad_token_id: 50256` and `bos_token_id: 50256` to model.cfg and normalized tokenizer with NFKC. Uploaded diff: gs://redwood-models/atlas/7b/qlora-v2/tokenizer-fixes/

alex_w: Nice. I'll update the catalog draft with the bench link and the config fixes. For rollout, add a fallback to `atlas-7b-qlora-int8` and a max_batch=8 for the hosted plan to avoid the p95 regressions. @sophia_r can you review the rollout snippet? :pray:

sophia_r: Sure — small nits: add `quant_profile: dynamic` and `max_latency_ms: 250` for the hosted route, and set `max_batch: 8` for the PLG tier. Otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

jonah_k: I'll re-run the bench with `--quant dynamic` and reduce warmup to 30 iters to get the int8 profile numbers. Scheduling tonight, will push artifacts to the same folder.

infra-bot: artifact upload confirmed -> gs://redwood-bench/artifacts/bench-1832054420/summary.json (sha256: a3f4...c9)

alex_w: Great work. Plan: maria finalize tokenizer PR, jonah rerun int8 bench + attach new summary, sophia review rollout. Once PR + artifacts linked, I'll mark thread as ready-for-catalog and request a quick CR. Thanks all. :rocket:
